research_status: iterative 2014-2023 rule freeze; all years are observed research evidence and none is represented as pristine validation
economic_hypothesis: A short breadth rebound is not sufficient evidence of a bull phase. Tradable sector diffusion requires broad participation over both 20 and 60 completed sessions. When that medium-term market participation is present, a sharp PIT industry breadth ignition can transmit into a still-underextended stock through its first controlled, non-limit pressure break.
independence: No collapse-gap, true-gap, gap-repair, V24 quiet-platform identity, or V26 120-session ceiling identity is used.

four_binding_conditions.MEDIUM_TERM_MARKET_PARTICIPATION: completed-session executable-universe positive-ret20 share >=65% and positive-ret60 share >=45%; market median ret20 >-3%
four_binding_conditions.PIT_INDUSTRY_IGNITION: industry median ret20 >3%, industry positive-ret20 share >60%, industry median ret20 rises >=3 percentage points over five completed sessions, and industry positive-ret20 share rises >=25 percentage points
four_binding_conditions.UNDEREXTENDED_FIRST_PRESSURE_BREAK: stock ret60 in [0%,15%], no prior20 limit-up close, and completed close exceeds the prior completed 20-session high
four_binding_conditions.CONTROLLED_ACTIVE_DEMAND: signal return in [2%,6%], close location >=70%, and signal turnover is in [1.5x,4.0x] prior20 mean

entry: first legal daily open strictly after the signal, within three exchange sessions
target: +15% coordinate standing target from the first T+1-sellable session
time_stop: completed H15 state, then next legal daily open

evidence_governance.2021_2023: observed chronological robustness diagnostic; not pristine validation
evidence_governance.post_2023_daily_rows: permitted only to resolve positions signaled no later than 2023-12-31
